title: S6: gate scorer adapter, GlyphIndex to the held-out ground truth (ADR 0008)
description: Gate scorer for ADR 0008 / DEC-303 (a2)-(a3): scores a GlyphIndex against the committed held-out ground truth (click 7.1.2) and the requests set (3c7baaa, pyright-comparable gt3 and the independent GCLI-74 classification) under both recall denominators and both precision sides; site-level Wilson gates, cluster bootstrap for information; per-bin unresolved shares beside recall. Built and tested against stub indexes, no analyzer.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The scorer reports recall under the all-attributable and pyright-comparable denominators and precision on the independent and comparable sides, site-level Wilson and a cluster bootstrap, per Addendum 4
Tests with stub indexes pin the numbers both ways and a mutation of each convention changes the output

implementationNotes: S6 landed at 341692f (Sonnet specialist). Mapping reading: a GlyphIndex symbol's qualified name is name, or container + '.' + name; a nested-function target needs container to carry the enclosing qualified name (Parameter.type_cast_value._convert needs container Parameter.type_cast_value) or the gate exits 6 on those two batch-0 targets; to flag to the analyzer slices. python3 -I -m unittest test_gate_score does not work on Python 3.15 (-I implies safe_path); working forms: python3 -I test_gate_score.py (14 tests OK) or python3 -I -m unittest discover -s . -p test_gate_score.py. Requests reader reports the independent side not scorable (now superseded by GCLI-74's classification: follow-up to read classified-requests-independent.json, overload-groups.json and the extended evidence file). Worker re-ran the 14 tests at 341692f: OK.

54ca537: requests scored under both denominators and both precision sides (25 tests: 14 click + 11 requests; python3 -I test_gate_score.py). Merge 082afeb of test/GCLI-74-requests-independent; one README conflict (both sections kept). Opus review at 54ca537 returned CHANGES: BLOCKER constructor crediting (decision: ruling 1 already says the analyzer records a construction against the class AND its resolved __init__, so the scorer's per-edge matching stays; README and a new test pin the analyzer requirement of two edges per construction, ceiling 59/65 = 0.9077, Wilson lower 0.8129; ADR 0008 and gt_rules_click.md sentences fixed on test/GCLI-69 (3e2bd37), merged into this branch); should-fix: pin input sha256, floor assertion (62), pending repository verdict line, duplicate/overlap rejection, uniqueness, extra exit-6 tests, README fixes. Routed to opum-doc by the leader: container contract (whole enclosing qualified name; src/types.ts says nearest enclosing class) and the repository verdict rule. S4 and S5 briefs must carry: container = whole enclosing qualified name; a construction is emitted as two edges (class and resolved __init__ along the MRO, including inherited __init__ for subclass constructions).

SUPERSEDING NOTE (2026-11-23, DEC-303 (a5) Q6 arm A): the earlier notes at 341692f and 54ca537 that say 'S4 and S5 briefs must carry: container = whole enclosing qualified name' are SUPERSEDED. The contract is the additive OPTIONAL qualname field on Python symbols: the full enclosing dotted name WITHOUT the PEP 3155 <locals> segment (e.g. Parameter.type_cast_value._convert); container keeps its documented meaning (nearest enclosing class); the scorer reads qualname and a target symbol lacking it is exit 6; absent for TypeScript. Round-2 head fe3d348 (merge ec56062 of test/GCLI-69 plus one commit): python3 -I test_gate_score.py 39 tests OK; ground-truth directories byte-identical to 44e70cb; implements constructor requirement tests (one edge per construction scores 59/65 requests, 78/80 click; two edges 65/65, 80/80), independent-side-only REPOSITORY VERDICT with the comparable block as baseline comparison, qualname reading, pinned sha256 inputs, duplicate/overlap rejection, refused non-default truth dir, the 62-site floor, uniqueness and exit-6 tests, README fixes. Opus round 2 at fe3d348: CHANGES on two small items plus non-blocking fixes (floor test must render with non_gating=False, repository_verdict None when unsuitable, stale notes, wording); the fix commit follows on this branch. Recorded exception: test/python-gate/click-7.1.2/gt_rules_click.md line 40 was edited in place at 3e2bd37 under the leader's decision, so 'no ground-truth file edited' holds with that stated. ACs stay unchecked until the fix commit passes review.

ACs 1-3 checked on the evidence at 07492f8 (leader accepted by ref): AC1 scorer prints recall and precision under both denominators with site-level Wilson and bootstrap, Opus tied every number by hand at fe3d348 (59/65 0.8129-0.9570, 78/80, 68/70, 72/80, 62/70, 57/65); AC2 python3 -I test_gate_score.py 41 tests OK incl. mutation tests and the floor-test mutation shown red then green; AC3 git diff fe3d348..07492f8 over click-7.1.2, requests-3c7baaa and test/python-lsp-measurement is empty, with the recorded exception gt_rules_click.md l.40 edited in place at 3e2bd37 under the leader's decision. Head 07492f8: lore check 0/0.
